_about: Refreshed from Eventbrite by tools/build.mjs --refresh (twice a day in GitHub Actions): `upcoming` mirrors the organiser's live, non-cancelled events; when an event ends it moves to `past` (newest first) and stays there. `overrides` (keyed by Eventbrite event id) lets you add a talk title or speaker, or hide an event, without touching Eventbrite.
